hello.title: This is the review
hello.text: Here you review your words, the most forgotten first. A quick look around, then how to answer.

progress.title: How far you are
progress.text: Which deck you review, how many cards are left and how much of this session is done.

undo.title: Undo an answer
undo.text: Answered wrong by mistake? This button (or the Z key) brings the last card back.

task.title: Task and level
task.text: On the left what to do now, on the right the level of this word. Each right answer moves it up, and the task gets harder.

mode.title: How you study
mode.text: Mixed (recommended), flash cards, the four-choice test or sentences: switch any time. Words and progress are shared.

card.title: The card
card.text: The word or the task itself. Everything needed is on the card; nothing to scroll.

answer.title: Answering
answer.text: The grade buttons or “Next”. Every answer is saved at once, so you can leave any time.

finish.title: Finish
finish.text: Back to Home. The button fills up as you get closer to today’s goal.

bye.title: Now, how to answer
bye.text: Next, a short word on how this kind of task works.

hello.title: These are your words
hello.text: All the words you study, and everything to add new ones.

actions.title: Add words
actions.text: One word, a whole list, your decks or ready decks from the library.

find.title: Find a word
find.text: Search by word or translation, and the order: due soon or not soon.

list.title: Your words
list.text: The bar shows how well a word is remembered. Tap a word for details, an example and “I have learned it”.

backup.title: Backup
backup.text: Your words live in this browser only. Save a copy to a file so nothing gets lost.

hello.title: Deck library
hello.text: Ready decks by level and topic. Take a whole deck or just the words you need.

tools.title: Search and filters
tools.text: Find a deck by name, filter by level or progress and sort. Unfinished decks always come first.

deck.title: A deck
deck.text: Tap a deck: all its words, “Add the whole deck” and picking words by swiping.

hello.title: Your decks
hello.text: Decks only decide what goes into your one big deck, and let you review part of your words on its own.

all.title: The whole deck
all.text: All your words reviewed together, the most forgotten first.

create.title: New deck
create.text: Make a deck of your own: only for work or travel, for example.

deck.title: A deck
deck.text: “Review” goes through its words only. The “⋯” menu renames, duplicates, archives or deletes it.

addWord.title: The “Find” button
addWord.text: Type a word and press “Find”: its translations and examples show up. Pick the ones you need, and the word is ready.
